images.title: Eight lines of symmetry
images.purpose: Show that an eight pointed paper star has 4 lines through opposite tips and 4 through opposite dips, 8 in all.
images.composition: One large star in the centre with eight lines, lots of white space around it.
images.exact_structure: One eight pointed star, teal #0072B2, with 8 equal tips and 8 equal dips. 4 thin lines in amber #E69F00 through opposite tips, and 4 thin lines in reddish purple #CC79A7 through opposite dips, all through the centre, alternating, each line 22.5 degrees from the next, 8 lines in all. Exactly 1 star, 8 lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The star has 8 lines of symmetry.
images.description: A teal eight pointed star with four amber lines through opposite tips and four reddish purple lines through opposite dips, 8 in all.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the lines through tips, then through dips, and add.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
